text: DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION: Copilot review finding on PR #408 — use openat-with-directory-fd (openat2) for full directory-hop TOCTOU closure in checkpoint_readnofollow_unix.go. DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION: Copilot review thread PRRT_kwDORzozKM6fDmom on PR #408 — CleanupCheckpoints classifies eligibility with readCheckpointFileNoFollow then archives via os.Rename on the original path. A concurrent writer replacing the file between read and rename could cause archiving of the wrong file. This is a pre-existing TOCTOU in CleanupCheckpoints (not introduced by U1 symlink hardening). Fix requires content re-verification at rename boundary (similar to moveNoReplace's bytes.Equal check) or handle-relative rename. Reason out of scope: P-021 C1 — U1's contract is symlink rejection in read verbs; addressing file-replacement TOCTOU in cleanup exceeds that scope. Source refs: task=153.001-T, feature=153-F, shipment=135-S, PR=#408, review-thread=PRRT_kwDORzozKM6fDmom. Requires deliberation: true. Kind: bug. Priority: medium (provisional).

DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION (from #423 adversarial Security review, cycles 3 + PR-review round 13): Cryptographic authenticity AND authenticated operator/invocation authorization for shipment lifecycle reconciliation. #423's governed archived-shipment->shipped repair is an EXPLICIT-CONFIRMATION + AUDITED approval workflow with strong integrity binding (trusted-ref-reachable MERGE COMMIT + manifest-matching structured closure with a deterministic delivery-merge grammar + content-hash + durable audited event + optional two-party --second-approver + a deterministic --confirm/TTY confirmation phrase). TWO explicit accepted residuals, both requiring an EXTERNAL trust anchor backlogit does not have: (1) CRYPTO AUTHENTICITY - a workspace writer who can hand-edit files could forge a consistent frontmatter+event (as they could any file-based state); signature/MAC attestation with an external trust anchor (e.g. CI/release-system signed delivery attestation) would close it. (2) AUTHENTICATED INVOCATION AUTHORIZATION - #423's issue text asks for an operator-AUTHORIZED repair, but an autonomous caller can self-supply the --confirm phrase or allocate a TTY, so the v1 gate is CONFIRMATION (guard against silent/accidental invocation) + ATTRIBUTION (audit), NOT machine-authenticated authorization. The #423 requirement is CONSCIOUSLY REVISED to confirmation-only for v1; genuine authenticated operator approval (an operator-issued, per-invocation credential the agent cannot mint - e.g. a signed authorization token, an out-of-band approval channel, or a hardware-backed operator key) is tracked HERE as a separate follow-up. C1 rationale: adding an external-trust-anchor signing/authorization capability is a SEPARATE security-infrastructure capability, NOT the exact authorized change in #423. Source: PR/issue #423, plan docs/exec-plans/2026-09-05-423-...-plan.md Plan Review cycle 3 Security SEC-01 + doctor-spoof, PR #424 review round 13 (confirmation-vs-authorization). Requires deliberation. Provisional priority: high.
